projects.name: 2025-2026 Legislative Agenda: bottle bill, plastic bags, polystyrene and clean energy bills
projects.description: Pushes state bills to expand the bottle bill, cut plastic bags and polystyrene, set clean lighting and appliance efficiency standards, and speed permitting for solar and virtual power plants.

projects.name: Energy Conservation & Efficiency
projects.description: Urges state senators not to weaken energy efficiency programs in pending energy legislation.

actions.name: Tell All-Clad: Go PFAS-free
actions.description: Sign a petition asking cookware maker All-Clad to stop using PFAS chemicals.

fields.description: The western Massachusetts sanctuaries of Mass Audubon, New England's largest nature conservation nonprofit, including Arcadia in Easthampton/Northampton and Pleasant Valley in Lenox. They run nature programs, protect and restore habitat such as floodplain forest, and work on biodiversity and climate change.

projects.name: Restoring Floodplain Forest at Arcadia
projects.description: Arcadia is turning 8.5 acres of field into floodplain forest of pin oak, silver maple and American elm, planted with the changing climate in mind.

actions.name: Volunteer at Arcadia Wildlife Sanctuary
actions.description: Help with visitor services, education, property stewardship and more at the sanctuary.

fields.description: Statewide Unitarian Universalist organizing and advocacy group, founded in 2006, that mobilizes UUs and congregations in Massachusetts to work with coalitions on justice issues, including climate and energy legislation.

events.name: A Gathering of Resilience and Spirit
events.location: Boston; closing service at First Church in Roxbury Meetinghouse
events.description: Afternoon with UU Urban Ministry featuring a community volunteer fair, food, communal poetry and a worship service.

events.name: Abolition, Decarceration, and Community
events.description: Conversation with Families for Justice as Healing organizers about prison abolition and how to get involved.

fields.description: The oldest urban Indian center in Massachusetts, based in Jamaica Plain since 1974, offering cultural, social, educational and employment services to Native people. Its programs include a community garden and food forest, energy bill help, and a tribal environmental justice listening session.

events.name: Indigenous Peoples Day March
events.location: Starts at Park Street Station, Boston
events.description: March for Indigenous Peoples Day listed on NAICOB's 2026 events calendar.

events.name: Annual Community Feast
events.location: North American Indian Center of Boston, 105 South Huntington Ave, Jamaica Plain

projects.name: NAICOB Garden & Food Forest
projects.description: Community garden and food forest at the center, with volunteer days and community meetings.

fields.description: All-volunteer group that helps Brookline renters, homeowners, landlords and businesses cut greenhouse gas emissions from buildings, transportation and electricity, toward the town's net-zero-by-2040 goal. It holds monthly public meetings and weighs in on climate-related Town Meeting articles.

events.name: November 2026 CAB Meeting - Town Meeting Warrant Articles
events.description: Discussion and possible endorsements of climate-related warrant articles for fall Town Meeting; all are welcome.

projects.name: Electrify Brookline
projects.description: Town-wide campaign with the Town's Zero Emissions Advisory Board and Brookline Mothers Out Front that offers how-to guides, incentive summaries and a contractor list to help residents electrify homes and vehicles.

projects.name: Public EV Charging
projects.description: Members work with the Town's Transportation Division to expand use and locations of public EV chargers for residents without home charging.

fields.description: Member-led grassroots organization in Springfield, founded in 1985, that organizes poor and working-class people on housing, homelessness, criminalization and racism. Its Environmental Justice Committee and the Springfield Climate Justice Coalition work against environmental racism and for climate action in the city.

projects.name: Springfield Climate Justice Coalition
projects.description: Coalition convened by Arise on climate justice in Springfield, including pushing for a city climate action and resiliency plan.

projects.name: Environmental Justice Committee
projects.description: Member committee that spreads word about threats to community health and organizes to stop them.

actions.name: Join Arise's volunteer mailing list
actions.description: Sign up to hear about volunteer opportunities with Arise for Social Justice.

actions.name: Join the CCL South Shore chapter
actions.description: Sign up to join volunteers on the South Shore, South Coast and Cape Cod who talk with neighbors and meet members of Congress about climate solutions.

projects.name: Make Big Oil Pay
projects.description: Campaign to have major oil companies pay a share of the cost of climate damage in Vermont.

projects.name: Keep Vermont Cool
projects.description: Campaign to cut the pollution that drives global warming in Vermont.

actions.name: Add your name: Keep Vermont Cool
actions.description: Sign on in support of cutting climate pollution in Vermont.

actions.name: Add your name: Make Big Oil Pay
actions.description: Show support for making Big Oil companies help pay for climate damage.

events.name: East End Forum
events.location: Schmanska Park Barn, 63 Grove Street, Burlington, VT
events.description: Public meeting with city staff and officials about walking and biking infrastructure in Burlington's East End.

events.name: Winooski Walk & Roll to School Day 2026
events.description: Walking and rolling school bus with pickup points along a route to school.

events.name: Burlington Halloween Roll & Stroll
events.description: Costumed community bike ride and walk with two route options, departing at 2 PM and ending at Old Spokes Home.

events.name: Smart Cycling Fall Workshop
events.location: Online (Oct 29) and Burlington area on-bike session (Nov 1, 2-5 PM)
events.description: Two-session bike safety class covering road rules, visibility, route planning and on-bike skills.

projects.name: Streets as Places
projects.description: Small grants and support for block parties and other projects that turn streets into community spaces across Vermont.

projects.name: Complete Streets advocacy
projects.description: Advocacy for streets designed for safe walking, biking and transit.

actions.name: Volunteer with Local Motion
actions.description: Help at Local Motion programs and events such as valet bike parking and community rides.
